observations: Photo 0 shows a manual sewing machine with a foot pedal and power cord.
The brand 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' and 'Super Mechanical' are printed on the front of the machine in photo 0.
The machine has a digital display screen on the top panel.
The machine body and base show significant surface dirt and grime.
The foot pedal is black and appears to be in good condition.
The power cord is coiled and shows some wear.

risks.risk: The needle may be bent or the presser foot may be damaged.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
